request.prompt: Use input 1 as the Buki two-page app structure and input 2 as brand mood. Create a bold modern full-screen mobile scrapbook UI for children. Keep the top brand area simple, center a clearly open two-page book, retain one floating camera action. Make both pages visibly gridded with generous white gutters and separate artwork frames; emphasize a clean center crease, magnetic color tabs, asymmetric color-block corners, and rounded toy-like geometry. Candy Color Block palette: cobalt #3567D6, tangerine #FF8A3D, berry pink #F45B9A, mint #61CDBB, lemon #FFE15A, ivory #FFF8ED, warm cream background #FBF2E5. Energetic but controlled, premium and contemporary, accessible contrast, practical to reproduce in Expo and Skia. No phone frame, no unrelated words, no illegible text, no realistic room.
